# `assets/humanoid/FingerMapper.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/humanoid/FingerMapper.js`

engine/assets/humanoid/FingerMapper.js — detect EXISTING finger bones under a hand node by name (Mixamo "LeftHandIndex1..3", VRM "J_Bip_L_Index_Proximal", generic "index_01"), grouping them into canonical fingers with palm→tip joint order. Used before procedural generation: if the artist rigged fingers, keep them; only synthesize when none are found.

## Functions

### `mapFingers(model, handNodeId)`

Map existing finger bones under a hand node.

**Parameters:**

- `model` *(object)* — EngineModel
- `handNodeId` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** }
